outcome: clinical course of COVID-19 in pregnancy (severity, symptoms, lab changes)
cohort: The study participants included 66 pregnant women with PCR-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection and their 42 neonates.
finding: The study found that COVID-19 in pregnant women was mostly mild, though severe cases (9%) contributed to preterm delivery or maternal morbidity, with no evidence of vertical transmission.
gest_age: Both preterm and term deliveries were included (19% preterm, 81% term)
